ModMetaData.name: Armor Integrity 1.1
ModMetaData.author: PhillipFrei
ModMetaData.description: Armor Integrity 1.1 for RimWorld 1.6. Armor is processed from outer to inner using RimWorld/Armored Up layer order. Remaining damage and AP can continue through exhausted layers, with a configurable extra damage-transfer factor. Apparel loses real HP with fractional wear preserved; intrinsic armor uses regenerating Battered. The single armor bar follows the current outermost armor on the body part of the most recent armor-relevant hit.
